instrumentation.method: Instruction-boundary observer decodes the effective address of each completed NMOS 6502 store and journals old/new values for divider, character ring, missile DMA and P0-P3 DMA. End-of-frame displayed snapshots retain physical address, physical row, logical row, ring head, first writer and active-owner mask.

result.reason_inconclusive: No non-background visible character cell without a consistent active owner survived across ring-head changes after a Raider kill, and no ownerless P0-P3 or missile-DMA byte persisted. The automated production replay therefore did not reproduce the owner's specific artifact and cannot identify its first writer.

closest_observed_confounder.classification: legitimate active gameplay debris, not accepted as the owner artifact
closest_observed_confounder.exclusion_reason: ENTITY_ACTIVE_MASK bit 0 remained set and ENTITY_X/Y matched the displayed two-cell footprint on every sampled publication. It was present before the kill and followed the normal gameplay-debris update/render lifecycle.
